summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to ¥99.00 from ¥92.00 forecast, with year-end dividend increased to ¥52.00 from ¥48.00, reflecting upward revision of FY2027 earnings guidance driven by strong semiconductor-related demand.
title_en: Notice of Revisions to Consolidated Financial Forecasts and Dividend Forecasts (Increase in Dividends)
translation_en_brief:
TOCALO Co., Ltd. revised upward its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The annual dividend per share has been increased to ¥99.00 from the previously forecasted ¥92.00, with the year-end dividend raised to ¥52.00 from ¥48.00 (the interim dividend remains at ¥47.00 as actual payment). This dividend increase follows an upward revision of the company's full-year earnings guidance, including consolidated net income attributable to parent company shareholders increased to ¥11,700 million from ¥10,860 million and earnings per share raised to ¥196.72 from ¥182.60.

The revision reflects stronger-than-expected performance in the second quarter and continued robust orders in semiconductor-related business anticipated for the second half of the fiscal year. The full-year sales forecast was raised to ¥73,000 million from ¥68,500 million, operating profit to ¥17,600 million from ¥16,700 million, and ordinary profit to ¥17,800 million from ¥16,700 million.

The increased dividend is supported by an improved payout ratio: the revised annual payout ratio stands at 50.3%, up from the previously anticipated level implied by the ¥92.00 forecast.
